# Queensland Public Service Salary Scales
## QLD Administrative Salary Guide by Classification
### AO 3 Salary — Administrative Officer Level 3
AnAO 3 (also written as AO3 or Administrative Officer Level 3) earns **$81,032–$89,903** gross — roughly $65,000–$71,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus12% employer super (~$91,000–$101,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the AO 3 salary?
An Administrative AO 3 (also written as AO3 or Administrative Officer Level 3) earns $81,032 to $89,903 per year as set by the Queensland Public Service Officers and Other Employees Award – State 2015 (reprinted 1 September 2026).
